orientation: This is a deterministic multi-agent research environment.
You can run an experiment, inspect why a decision occurred, inject a failure, compare policies, or replay a previous run.

status.remote_judgment: OFF in this static export (every judgment shown was made by a deterministic local judge)

capabilities.statement: run a deterministic multi-agent simulation (14 scenarios)
run a controlled experiment with repetitions and paired statistics (7 manifests)
compare validation, judgment, or gating policies under identical seeds
replay the most recent run (perturbed-mesh.default.r000.s42) with zero network calls
re-run a recorded run with judgment disabled and show where the timelines diverge
explain why a decision happened by walking its causal chain

inject faults: sensor_dropout, observation_delay, stale_telemetry, corrupt_observation, invalidate_observation, duplicate_proposal, clock_skew, freeze_agent, disable_judge, judge_timeout, network_unavailable, judge_latency, human_state_dropout, human_state_degraded
capabilities.command: mesh run scenarios/perturbed-mesh.yaml --set 'faults=[{kind: judge_timeout, at_tick: 5, duration_ticks: 10}]'

capabilities.statement: ablate judgment with deterministic offline judges (evidence-heuristic, contrarian)
test TypeSafe Jev against deterministic-only execution
capabilities.reason: depends on the local installation; not part of a static export

capabilities.statement: export an evidence bundle (events, decisions, metrics, provenance, report)
attach an external deliberative agent (R.A.I.N. adapter protocol mesh-agent/1)
capabilities.reason: depends on the local installation; not part of a static export

capabilities.statement: verify the committed golden recordings still replay exactly
check research claims against recorded experiment evidence
serve the research cockpit API and live sessions
accept LIVE human-state data from a registered source
